anomalies.2031: Roughly half of every pro roster was floored to rating 3 by a roster-guard bug that ran all season, so the middle of the league collapsed and the few real players feasted. League mean 5.79 points a game against 8.9-9.9 in every other season, and a top mark of 49.0 against a previous best of 32.9. Davis Plowden scored 49.0 a game in 2031 and 25.6 in 2032, after the rosters were repaired.
